scripts.lint: npm run typecheck && node scripts/check-source-hygiene.mjs && node scripts/check-ux-correctness.mjs && node scripts/check-accessibility-foundations.mjs && node scripts/check-navigation-ia.mjs && node scripts/check-home-simplification.mjs && node scripts/check-feature-ux-completion.mjs && node scripts/check-design-system.mjs && node scripts/check-release-polish.mjs
